candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show the failing hop is payment, not inventory (reservations succeed 200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry (logs/metrics/traces) is present; the 503 root cause inside payment is unobserved.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are caused by order returning 502, which traces attribute to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Bounded to the observed failing hop; payment-internal cause remains unobserved.
